title: An albumin–globulin interaction adds no reliable log-CRP prediction gain across independent NHANES samples
abstract: Adding a prespecified albumin-by-globulin interaction to a nonlinear conventional-ratio/component model did not reliably improve concurrent log-CRP prediction in independent NHANES 2009–10 participants: delta MSE -0.000095 (95% approximate paired source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap interval -0.003442 to 0.001200). Source fitting used 5,219 adults; confirmation used 5,616 adults. Cubic and unweighted challenges did not establish a robust incremental marker. The outcome is concurrent inflammation, not future disease.
